title: Ball B post-collision speed
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) must be the correct speed of ball B after the elastic collision (20 m/s).

title: Track radius R
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) must be the correct radius of the semicircular track (0.4 m).

title: Distance between landing points
description: Essential: The final answer for part (3) must be the correct expression or value for the horizontal separation distance ((16√6 - 6)/5 m).

title: Elastic collision application
description: Important: The solution must correctly apply conservation of momentum and kinetic energy to find the post-collision velocities.

title: Energy balance at point N
description: Important: For ball A, the solution must relate its speed at the highest point to the given normal force using Newton's second law for circular motion.

title: Projectile motion analysis
description: Important: The solution must correctly determine the common flight time from the vertical drop of 2R and compute horizontal displacements.

title: Energy conservation on track
description: Optional: The solution may explicitly show the use of mechanical energy conservation to find the speeds of the balls at the track's exit point N.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student incorrectly assigns signs to velocities in the collision equations or misinterprets the normal force direction.

title: Unit inconsistency
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student fails to use consistent units (kg, m, s) or omits units in final answers where required.
